info.name: Adesua - Member B (courses, lessons, instructor courses)
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint Member B owns, matching docs/API_CONTRACT.md. Each request has two saved example responses under it: a success and an error.

Environments
Use the environment files in docs/postman/:
- Adesua local (`adesua-local.postman_environment.json`): the backend on your computer. The examples come from a freshly seeded local database.
- Adesua production (`adesua-production.postman_environment.json`): the live API on Render (see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md). The first request after a quiet period can take up to a minute. Requests that create, change or delete courses and lessons change the live data.

How to use
1. Import this file and the environment you need, then choose that environment (top right).
2. Run Auth > Log in as instructor first. It saves the token as `{{token}}`, and the other requests send it automatically.
3. Open this collection's Variables tab and set `categoryId` to the `_id` of a category (GET /api/categories lists them).
4. Run Courses > Create a course. It saves the new draft's `_id` as `{{courseId}}`.
5. Run Lessons > Add a lesson. It saves the lesson's `_id` as `{{lessonId}}`.
6. Run Publish or unpublish a course, then Get a published course to see what the public course page gets.
7. Delete a lesson and Delete a course remove what you made. The last lesson of a published course can't be deleted, so unpublish the course first.

exec: // Save the token so the other requests can send it as {{token}}.

request.description:
Purpose: Log in as an instructor, for the course, lesson and instructor requests. Returns a token that the other requests send automatically.

Access: Public. Limited to 20 sign-up or login attempts per 15 minutes per IP address.

Body (JSON):
- `email` (required)
- `password` (required)

The seeded instructors are kwame@example.com and ama@example.com. Every seeded account uses the password `Demo1234`.

Parameters: none.

This request saves the returned token as `{{token}}`.

response.name: Logged in (200)
Wrong email or password (401)

request.description:
Purpose: List published courses, with search, filters, sorting and pages.

Access: Public.

Body: none.

Parameters (query, all optional):
- `search`: part of a title, ignoring capital letters
- `category`: a category slug, like `web-development`
- `level`: `beginner`, `intermediate` or `advanced`
- `price`: `free` or `paid`
- `sort`: `newest` (the default), `popular`, `price_asc` or `price_desc`
- `page`: default 1
- `limit`: default 9, at most 50

Drafts never appear here.

response.name: Courses (200)
Invalid page (400)

request.description:
Purpose: One published course with its instructor, category and lesson outline, for the course page.

Access: Public.

Body: none.

Parameters:
- `courseId` in the URL: the course's `_id`. Create a course saves it.

Lessons come in order. Only preview lessons include `videoUrl` and `content`. A draft gives 404, the same as an unknown course.

request.description:
Purpose: Create a course. It starts as a draft with no lessons.

Access: Instructor.

Body (JSON):
- `title` (required): 5 to 120 characters
- `shortDescription` (required): up to 160 characters
- `description` (required): at least 20 characters
- `whatYouWillLearn`: up to 6 short points
- `category` (required): a category `_id`, from the `categoryId` variable
- `price` (required): 0 to 5,000, where 0 makes the course free
- `level` (required): `beginner`, `intermediate` or `advanced`
- `thumbnailUrl`: a full `https://` link, or empty to use the category cover

Other fields, like `status` or `studentCount`, are ignored.

Parameters: none.

This request saves the course's `_id` as `{{courseId}}`.

request.description:
Purpose: Add a lesson to a course. The course's `lessonCount` and `totalMinutes` go up.

Access: The course's instructor.

Body (JSON):
- `title` (required): 3 to 120 characters
- `videoUrl`: a YouTube link (watch, youtu.be or embed)
- `content`: the lesson notes
- `durationMinutes` (required): 1 to 300
- `isPreview`: true shows the video and notes on the public course page
- `order`: 1 or more. Leave it out to add the lesson at the end.

A lesson needs a YouTube link, notes, or both.

Parameters:
- `courseId` in the URL.

This request saves the lesson's `_id` as `{{lessonId}}`.
